title: Intentional Imbalance
coreMove: Give disproportionate attention to the few actions that matter most, while naming what is being deferred and why.
sourcePressure: The chapter argues for deliberate imbalance around priorities while preserving the limit against reckless neglect.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Using imbalance as permission to neglect obligations permanently or selfishly.

sourceAnchors.name: Intentional Imbalance
sourceAnchors.detail: The verified chapter title frames imbalance as deliberate rather than accidental.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Intentional imbalance is a chosen tilt toward the work that carries the cycle.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps
